chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Two groups from my nation have no share in Islam: one who sets up war against the People of my House, and one who is extreme in religion, having departed from it.

key_terms.أَهْلِ بَيْتِي: The People of my House, the Prophet’s family
key_terms.أُمَّتِي: My community or nation, referring to the Prophet’s followers
key_terms.الدِّينِ: The religion, meaning Islam and its proper bounds
key_terms.النَّاصِبُ: One who shows enmity and hostility, especially toward the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.صِنْفَانِ: Two categories or groups being identified
key_terms.غَالٍ: One who goes to excess or extremism
key_terms.مَارِقٌ: One who departs or breaks away from the religion

ai.seo_question: Which groups did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله condemn as having no share in Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith condemns two deviant groups: those who bear hostility toward the Ahl al-Bayt and those who exceed proper bounds in religion until they depart from it. It emphasizes loyalty to the Prophet’s household and warns against extremist excess in religious matters.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4425 - The Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"Two groups from my nation have no share in Islam: those who harbor enmity against my household and declare war against them, and those who are extreme in religion and deviate from it."
